form.pageSubtitle: Use this form to report a medical emergency. A trained response agent will be notified immediately.

callerPhone.label: Contact Number
callerPhone.description: We will use this number to follow up with you
callerPhone.error: Please enter a valid contact number

locationDescription.label: Location
locationDescription.placeholder: Street address, landmark, or area description
locationDescription.description: Be as specific as possible — include a landmark if you know one

presentingComplaint.label: What is happening?
presentingComplaint.placeholder: Describe the emergency — symptoms, injuries, or situation

personsAffected.label: Number of People Affected
personsAffected.error: Please enter the number of people affected (minimum 1)

preferredLanguage.label: Preferred Language
preferredLanguage.description: Tell us which language you are most comfortable with

consent.label: I consent to the information submitted in this form being used solely for the purpose of coordinating emergency medical assistance on my behalf.
consent.error: You must provide consent to submit this request

form.submitError: Something went wrong. Please try again or call the emergency line directly.
form.syntheticDataNotice: This is a demonstration system. All data is fictional and used for training purposes only.

confirmation.title: Emergency Request Received
confirmation.message: Your emergency request has been received. A trained response agent has been notified and will coordinate assistance immediately.
confirmation.referenceNote: Save this number. If you call us, quote this reference so we can find your case quickly.
confirmation.nextStep1: A response agent will review your request immediately.
confirmation.nextStep2: The agent will identify the nearest available hospital with the right capability.
confirmation.nextStep3: An ambulance will be dispatched to your location.
confirmation.agentNote: If you need to speak to someone urgently, call the emergency line shown below.

fallback.bannerMessage: If this system is unavailable or you need immediate help, call one of these numbers directly:
fallback.syntheticNotice: These are fictional contact numbers for demonstration purposes only.

nav.tagline: In an emergency, finding help should not become another emergency.
